# ERC7824 State channels framework

## Docs

- [ERC-7824](https://erc7824.org/erc-7824): Interfaces and data types for cross-chain stateful asset transfer
- [Guides](https://erc7824.org/guides/index): Comprehensive guides for working with Nitrolite and the ERC-7824 standard
- [Migration Guide](https://erc7824.org/guides/migration-guide): Guide to migrate to newer versions of Nitrolite
- [Introduction](https://erc7824.org/index): Build scalable web3 applications with state channels using Nitrolite.
- [Abstract Accounts](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/advanced/abstract-accounts): Using NitroliteClient with Account Abstraction
- [Erc20Service](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/advanced/erc20-service): Documentation for the ERC20Service class
- [Advanced Usage](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/advanced/index): Advanced topics for working with the NitroliteClient
- [NitroliteService](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/advanced/nitrolite-service): Documentation for the core NitroliteService class
- [Supported Signature Formats](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/advanced/supported-sig-formats): Documentation for supported signature formats in NitroliteClient
- [NitroliteClient](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/index): Nitrolite client SDK documentation
- [Methods](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/methods): Complete API reference for NitroliteClient
- [Type Definitions](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_client/types): Detailed type definitions used in the NitroliteClient
- [NitroliteRPC](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_rpc/index): Overview of the NitroliteRPC, its core logic, and links to detailed API and type definitions.
- [RPC Message Creation API](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_rpc/message_creation_api): Detailed reference for functions that create specific, signed Nitrolite RPC request messages.
- [RPC Type Definitions](https://erc7824.org/nitrolite_rpc/rpc_types): Comprehensive type definitions for the Nitrolite RPC protocol.
- [Create Application Sessions](https://erc7824.org/quick_start/application_session): Create and manage off-chain application sessions to interact with ClearNodes.
- [Channel Asset Management](https://erc7824.org/quick_start/balances): Monitor off-chain balances in your active state channels using NitroliteRPC.
- [Close Application Session](https://erc7824.org/quick_start/close_session): Properly close application sessions and finalize fund allocations using NitroliteRPC.
- [Connect to the ClearNode](https://erc7824.org/quick_start/connect_to_the_clearnode): Establish connection with ClearNode for reliable off-chain transaction processing and verification.
- [Quick Start](https://erc7824.org/quick_start/index): Learn how to use Nitrolite state channels from start to finish.
- [Create a Channel](https://erc7824.org/quick_start/initializing_channel): Create and configure a channel from your account at apps.yellow.com
